about: A boolean is exact in two places on a five-level chain and nowhere
else. That is the figure that earns the debit its place: two poles,
not one bit. `asBoolean` is the control, not a conversion utility.
The trap: an implementation that only counted well-formed units
(floor ≤ ceiling) would report 15 possibles and hide the ten
contradictions a boolean cannot speak. The sweep is every pair.

coverage.criterion: the five-chain (25 pairs) and the two-level chain (4 pairs), both exhaustive

cases.name: the two-level chain a boolean pretends to be
